# eTuitionHub (e-tuitionBD)

> Bangladesh's verified home and online tuition marketplace connecting students, parents, background-checked private educators, and coaching institutions with zero parent agency fees and escrow-protected tuition payments.

## Platform Identity & Scope
- **Name:** eTuitionHub (Brand: e-tuitionBD)
- **Primary Website:** https://e-tuitionhub.vercel.app
- **Headquarters:** Chattogram, Bangladesh (Serving all 8 divisions nationwide)
- **Support Contact:** mdadeel125@gmail.com | +880 15339-70377
- **Geographic Coverage:** Nationwide across all 8 administrative divisions of Bangladesh: Dhaka, Chattogram, Rajshahi, Sylhet, Khulna, Barishal, Rangpur, and Mymensingh, plus major districts including Comilla, Gazipur, and Narayanganj.
- **Key Metropolitan Hubs:** Dhanmondi, Gulshan, Banani, Uttara, Mirpur, Mohammadpur, Bashundhara, Panchlaish, Nasirabad, Agrabad, Khulshi, Chawkbazar, Zindabazar, Amberkhana, Boalia, Sonadanga.

## Supported Academic Curricula
1. **Bangla Medium:** Primary (Class 1–5), Lower Secondary (Class 6–8), Secondary (SSC / Class 9–10), Higher Secondary (HSC / Class 11–12), Science/Commerce/Humanities groups.
2. **English Version (NCTB Curriculum in English):** Class 1 through HSC.
3. **English Medium (British Curriculum):** Cambridge Assessment International Education (CAIE) and Pearson Edexcel (Checkpoint, IGCSE, O Levels, A Levels).
4. **International Baccalaureate (IB):** Primary Years Programme (PYP), Middle Years Programme (MYP), and Diploma Programme (DP).
5. **University Admission Prep:** BUET & Engineering (CKRUET), Medical Colleges (MBBS), Dhaka University (DU A/B/C units), IBA (BBA/MBA), BUP.
6. **Standardized Exams & Skills:** IELTS, TOEFL, SAT, Spoken English, Arabic & Quranic Studies, ICT & Computer Programming.

## 2026 Representative Monthly Tuition Fee Benchmarks (BDT)
*Rates reflect 3–4 days/week home or 1-on-1 online tuition and vary by city and tutor institution (BUET, DU, DMC, CUET, SUST, NSU, BRACU):*
- **Primary (Class 1–5):** ৳3,000 – ৳6,000 / month
- **Lower Secondary (Class 6–8):** ৳4,000 – ৳8,000 / month
- **SSC / Class 9–10 (Science / Higher Math):** ৳5,000 – ৳10,000 / month
- **HSC / Class 11–12 (Physics, Chemistry, Higher Math, Biology):** ৳7,000 – ৳15,000 / month
- **English Medium (O Levels / IGCSE):** ৳8,000 – ৳16,000 / month
- **English Medium (A Levels / IB):** ৳10,000 – ৳22,000 / month
- **University Admission / IBA / Medical Prep:** ৳8,000 – ৳18,000 / month

## Transparent Tutor & Parent Economics
- **0% Agency Fee for Parents & Students:** Browsing verified tutors, booking a free 30-minute trial class, and hiring tutors has zero matching fee for families.
- **Fair Tutor Commission:** Only 20% in Month 1 (12% for verified premium tutors) vs. 50–60% charged by traditional local tuition media. Subsequent months are 100% kept by the tutor (0% deduction).
- **SafePay™ Escrow Protection:** Parents deposit monthly fees via bKash, Nagad, Rocket, or Bank Transfer into platform escrow; funds release only after confirmed sessions, backed by a 100% free tutor replacement guarantee.
- **4-Tier Tutor Verification:** National ID (NID) check, university ID & academic transcript verification, phone validation, and ongoing parent review monitoring.
